title: mica
description: MiCAOracle — 24 tools for EU MiCA stablecoin compliance: peg, reserves, attestations.
summary: MiCAOracle — 24 tools for EU MiCA stablecoin compliance: peg, reserves, attestations.
offersHint: MiCAOracle — 24 tools for EU MiCA stablecoin compliance: peg, reserves, attestations. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://tooloracle.io/mica/mcp/

toolsPreview.name: readiness_check
toolsPreview.description: Full MiCA readiness score + Ampel per article for a token. GREEN/YELLOW/RED/GREY for 10 articles, score 0-100.

toolsPreview.name: article_status
toolsPreview.description: Detailed Ampel for a specific MiCA article with check conditions.

toolsPreview.name: gap_report
toolsPreview.description: MiCA compliance gaps: RED/YELLOW/GREY with priority and actions.

toolsPreview.name: assess_token
toolsPreview.description: Run LIVE MiCA assessment via FeedOracle mica_full_pack. Evaluates 18 checks, updates Ampel.

toolsPreview.name: entity_list
toolsPreview.description: List all registered entities.

toolsPreview.name: create_entity
toolsPreview.description: Register a new regulated entity.

toolsPreview.name: audit_trail
toolsPreview.description: Chain-linked audit log with integrity check.

toolsPreview.name: health_check
toolsPreview.description: Server + DB status.

toolsPreview.name: issuer_profile
toolsPreview.description: Issuer profile with all tokens and aggregate MiCA Ampel. Shows authorization status, headquarters, token scores.

toolsPreview.name: entity_ampel
toolsPreview.description: Aggregate MiCA Ampel for an entity across ALL tokens it custodies. Shows per-token breakdown + overall score.

toolsPreview.name: issuer_list
toolsPreview.description: List all known token issuers with MiCA authorization status and tokens.

toolsPreview.name: link_token
toolsPreview.description: Link a token to an entity for monitoring.

toolsPreview.name: assess_entity
toolsPreview.description: Assess ALL tokens for an entity in one call. Runs live FeedOracle assessment for each linked token.

toolsPreview.name: bridge_resolve
toolsPreview.description: Start bridge resolution for a MiCA gap. Generates template (issuer engagement, risk acceptance, token replacement, monitoring upgrade).

toolsPreview.name: bridge_approve
toolsPreview.description: Approve or reject a bridge resolution. Approval upgrades Ampel to GREEN.

toolsPreview.name: bridge_status
toolsPreview.description: Show all bridge resolutions for an entity/token.

toolsPreview.name: bus_status
toolsPreview.description: Oracle Event Bus status: events, cross-refs, connected oracles.

toolsPreview.name: freshness_check
toolsPreview.description: Expire stale evidence. Downgrades GREEN→YELLOW if evidence older than max_age_days. Run daily.

toolsPreview.name: mica_watchdog
toolsPreview.description: Monitor ESMA/EBA/BaFin for MiCA regulatory changes. Returns monitored sources and alerts.

toolsPreview.name: generate_report
toolsPreview.description: Generate MiCA compliance report for a token. Full article breakdown, evidence, bridges, audit.

toolsPreview.name: validate_whitepaper
toolsPreview.description: Validate crypto-asset whitepaper against MiCA Art. 6(10)-(11) and ITS 2024/2984. Checks iXBRL/XHTML format, taxonomy tagging, mandatory fields, risk warnings, NCA notification, version archive.

toolsPreview.name: insider_escalation
toolsPreview.description: Inside Information classification, delay and disclosure workflow per MiCA Art. 87-88 and Implementing Regulation 2024/2861. AI-assisted with mandatory human sign-off.

toolsPreview.name: stor_workflow
toolsPreview.description: Suspicious Transaction and Order Report (STOR) workflow per MiCA Art. 92. AI-assisted detection with mandatory human sign-off for 'reasonable suspicion'.

toolsPreview.name: eidas_timestamp
toolsPreview.description: eIDAS-qualified timestamp integration status and assessment. Maps FeedOracle ES256K signatures to EU trust framework (eIDAS Art. 25, 41-42).
